news.title:
SBI Cards confirms timely interest payment of Rs. 593.97 lakh net for NCDs on June 11, 2026.
The interest payment was made before the due date of June 12, 2026; no delays reported.

SBI Card's Q4FY26 net profit rose 14% YoY to ₹610 crore, aided by lower credit costs and improved asset quality.
Spends grew 31% YoY to ₹1.15 trillion, with corporate spends driving growth; NIM was stable at 10.3%.
SBICARD: Elevated P/E Assumptions Will Constrain Future Share Returns
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for SBI Cards and Payment Services steady at ₹500 per share. The latest price target reflects only minor tweaks to assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, rather than a change in overall conviction.

news.title: SBICARD: Higher Required Returns And Tighter Margins Will Pressure Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have reduced their price target for SBI Cards and Payment Services from ₹650 to ₹500, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margin, discount rate and forward P/E that support a more conservative fair value framework. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for March 5, 2026, to consider and approve the declaration and payment of an interim dividend on the equity shares for the 2025-26 financial year, and to review trading window norms under SEBI insider trading regulations (company filing).

news.title: Price target decreased by 8.2% to ₹746
news.body: Down from ₹812, the current price target is an average from 23 analysts. New target price is 14% above last closing price of ₹651. Stock is down 25% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹30.20 for next year compared to ₹22.77 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹22.77 (up from ₹20.15 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹126.7b (up 27% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹21.7b (up 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 17% (down from 19% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 1.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 6% per year and the company’s share price has also fallen by 6% per year.

What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on January 28, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.85 (up from ₹4.03 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹45.7b (up 84% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.57b (up 45% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (down from 16% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 3.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 6% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 1% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: SBICARD: Rich P/E And Firm Margins Will Likely Restrain Future Upside

What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on January 28, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).
